items.docs: Get a specific user on the account.

Modify an existing user. To deactivate a user, set the `active` field to `false`.

> ❗️ This is a hard delete. We recommend deactivating users instead of deleting them. To deactivate a user, use PUT or PATCH and set the active field to false.

Delete a user from the account. Note that certain users cannot be deleted, such as account owners and default document owners.

params.name: startIndex
params.description: Index of the first user in the list to return (1 indexed).

params.name: count
params.description: Quantity of users to return from this request.

params.name: filter
params.description:
See SCIM spec and optimization details below:
* The only operator currently supported is eq
* Filtered requests will result in a maximum of 10,000 users
* While filtering should technically work on every attribute of a user, it is a very slow process for non-optimized attributes. We strongly recommend filtering only on the following optimized attributes whenever possible:
  * email / emails.value / workemail
  * username / displayname
  * externalid
  * urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:lucid:1.0:User.productLicenses.<name>
